square_gate_quartic_C8.positive_gate: k=z^2 together with physical rho^2=2*(k^2+1) gives C8
square_gate_quartic_C8.negative_gate: -k=z^2 together with physical rho^2=2*(k^2+1) gives the same C8
square_gate_quartic_C8.infinity_reason: at projective infinity one would need (w/z^2)^2=2, impossible over Q

C8_rational_point_exhaustion.proof: the exact birational adapter accounts for all affine/projective exceptions, C8 has no rational infinity, and source-locked 32.a3 has rank 0 with torsion [2,2]
C8_rational_point_exhaustion.conclusion: C8(Q) consists exactly of the four displayed points

physical_nonsquare_gate.k_square: if k is a rational square then C8 forces k=1
physical_nonsquare_gate.minus_k_square: if -k is a rational square then C8 forces k=-1
physical_nonsquare_gate.boundary_exclusion: k=1 and k=-1 are both outside the retained physical domain
conclusion: k is not a rational square

two_primary_torsion_Ek.divisible_2_torsion: only (0,0) is rationally 2-divisible; the other two require -1 to be a rational square
two_primary_torsion_Ek.no_order8: if an order-4 point above T0 were itself doubled from Q, its x-coordinate k or -k would be a rational square, excluded by the physical nonsquare gate
two_primary_torsion_Ek.conclusion: E_k(Q)[2^infinity] is exactly Z/4 x Z/2 on every retained physical fiber

two_primary_torsion_Ek_prime.halving_criterion: a rational 2-torsion root e_i is divisible by 2 iff both root differences e_i-e_j and e_i-e_l are rational squares
two_primary_torsion_Ek_prime.root0: requires -(k+1)^2 and -(k-1)^2 to be squares; impossible on the retained domain
two_primary_torsion_Ek_prime.root_plus: requires 4*k to be a square, equivalently k square
two_primary_torsion_Ek_prime.root_minus: requires -4*k to be a square, equivalently -k square
two_primary_torsion_Ek_prime.conclusion: E'_k(Q)[2^infinity] is exactly (Z/2)^2 on every retained physical fiber
